selected_function_proof.DefWindowProcWorker: All nonblank lines in original555-565,580-904,1210-1213,1217 occur unchanged at their original logical lines; FE_IME/DEBUG bodies excluded, plus explicit added post-WM_MOVE destruction guard.

initial_review: Retain original default algorithm and finite binding. GetCPD is source-identical but product call sites lie in disabled alternatives; production object is removable, distinct from the still-used native NtUserGetCPD binding.
counter_review: Do not equate copied WND allocation lifetime with live HWND. WM_MOVE can retire the exact binding, so removing the guard is unsafe. Whole-file deletion is invalid: default client remains a product provider. Orphan FE_SB/LATER/FE_IME frames do not prove original enclosing function structure restored.
format_restoration: Original DefWindowProcWorker documentation546-553 restored; no executable/preprocessor token changed.
limits: Source comparison and test-source inspection only; fixtures were not run. Full original remainder is deliberately outside admitted USER slice, not proved unreachable in original NT.
